nodes.name: Called by Ingest Workflow
nodes.notes: Triggered by Workflow 1 after a new file is ingested. Also runs on schedule as a catch-all.

nodes.name: Catch-All Schedule (30 min)
nodes.notes: Safety net: processes any files stuck in 'pending' status every 30 minutes.

parameters.query:
SELECT id, gdrive_file_id, original_filename, mime_type, local_path, is_video, taken_at, process_attempts
FROM media_files
WHERE status = 'pending'
  AND process_attempts < 3
ORDER BY ingested_at ASC
LIMIT 20;

nodes.name: Load Pending Media
nodes.notes: Fetches up to 20 unprocessed files. Skips files that have failed 3+ times.

nodes.name: Is Video?
nodes.notes: Videos need keyframe extraction before face recognition.

nodes.name: Extract Video Keyframes
nodes.notes: Extracts up to 5 I-frames (keyframes) from the video using ffmpeg. These are used for face recognition only — the original video is what gets sent to friends.

nodes.name: Prepare Keyframe Items
nodes.notes: Splits keyframes into individual items for batch face recognition.

nodes.name: CompreFace: Recognize (Video Frames)
nodes.notes: Sends each keyframe to CompreFace for face recognition.

nodes.name: Read Photo from Disk
nodes.notes: Reads the photo file from media_cache into binary so CompreFace can process it.

nodes.name: CompreFace: Recognize (Photo)
nodes.notes: Sends the photo binary to CompreFace for face recognition.

nodes.name: Parse Recognition Results
nodes.notes: Filters faces above confidence threshold, deduplicates across keyframes, extracts friend names.

nodes.name: Assign Session (6hr Window)
nodes.notes: Deterministic session assignment based on 6-hour time windows. Same photo always maps to same session.

parameters.query:
-- Upsert the session (create if new, update if exists)
INSERT INTO hangout_sessions (id, session_name, started_at, ended_at, media_count, friends_present)
VALUES (
  uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), '{{ $json.sessionKey }}'),
  '{{ $json.sessionName }}',
  '{{ $json.windowStart }}',
  '{{ $json.windowEnd }}',
  1,
  ARRAY[{{ $json.friendsIdentified.map(f => "'" + f + "'").join(',') || "''" }}]::text[]
)
ON CONFLICT (id) DO UPDATE SET
  media_count = hangout_sessions.media_count + 1,
  friends_present = (
    SELECT ARRAY(SELECT DISTINCT unnest(
      hangout_sessions.friends_present || 
      ARRAY[{{ $json.friendsIdentified.map(f => "'" + f + "'").join(',') || "''" }}]::text[]
    ))
  ),
  updated_at = NOW()
RETURNING id;

nodes.name: Upsert Session
nodes.notes: Creates session if new, or updates existing session with new friend list and incremented media count.

parameters.query:
UPDATE media_files SET
  faces_detected = {{ $json.facesDetected || 0 }},
  faces_recognized = '{{ $json.facesRecognized }}'::jsonb,
  friends_identified = ARRAY[{{ $json.friendsIdentified.map(f => "'" + f + "'").join(',') || '' }}]::text[],
  session_id = uuid_generate_v5(uuid_ns_url(), '{{ $json.sessionKey }}'),
  status = 'processed',
  processed_at = NOW(),
  process_attempts = process_attempts + 1,
  updated_at = NOW()
WHERE id = '{{ $json.mediaId }}'::uuid;

nodes.name: Update Media Record
nodes.notes: Updates the media_files record with face recognition results, session assignment, and 'processed' status.
